notes.title: UPDATE FROM THE NEGOTIATION TABLE!
notes.notes:
Thank you for your overwhelming support. The negotiations with the celebrity union (FUFFF) have been... exhausting. They've returned to us not with a simple request, but with a three-part, diamond-encrusted, legally-binding list of demands.



It seems they require more than money and validation; they now demand creative input from the very public they scorn. To save Celebrity Kombat from being vaulted, we must meet ALL THREE of their ridiculous conditions.


[hr][/hr]


Demand #1: The Financial Rider (The Appeasement Fund)

First, the obvious. Their "Artistic Endeavor" fee is non-negotiable. Virtual private jets and ego-stroking assistants don't pay for themselves.

THE MISSION: We need to sell 1000 new copies of the game to fill their "Appeasement Fund." Every purchase helps meet their financial demands.


[hr][/hr]


Demand #2: The "Public Adoration Clause"

Their egos require constant praise. They refuse to be associated with a title rated as merely "Mixed," calling it "a statistical insult."

THE MISSION: We must raise the game's official Steam rating to "Mostly Positive." They demand proof of public adoration.


[hr][/hr]


Demand #3: The "Choreography Mandate"

And here's the latest absurdity. They claim their "flawless" combat techniques are being "poorly executed and misunderstood" by the player base. Therefore, they are mandating a public consultation to design new moves "worthy of their star power."

THE MISSION: The community must actively contribute to improving their move sets. We will create a dedicated thread on our Steam forums titled "The Official FUFFF Choreography Mandate." We need our best and brightest players to suggest new moves, combos, and finishers for our celebrity cast.


[hr][/hr]

This Is Our Three-Front War! Here's the Battle Plan:


Every single one of you is now a key part of this rescue operation.

For New Fighters & Wishlist Warriors: You lead the charge on Demand #1. Purchase Celebrity Kombat to fund the war chest. Every copy sold is a direct blow to their financial tyranny.

For Our Veteran Champions (Existing Owners):
You are the heart of our PR campaign for Demand #2. It costs nothing but a moment of your time. If you enjoy the game, please leave an honest review on our Steam page to help us reach "Mostly Positive."

For ALL Players, New and Old (The Creative Division):
Unleash your genius for Demand #3. Head to the "Choreography Mandate" thread in our Steam forums and give us your best ideas. Your suggestions will directly influence the future of combat in the game (if we save it!).



The objective is absolute. We must fill the fund, raise the rating, AND gather brilliant new ideas before the deadline on October 15th, 2025.



If we fail on even ONE of these fronts, the game is gone.

Let's show these divas the true power of a united community!



For the Future of the Fight,

The Team at Celebrity Kombat Corp.

notes.title: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE: There's Been a Coup!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Fighters,



We are writing this under duress. The digital denizens of Celebrity Kombat have done the unthinkable: they've unionized. We were negociating to add new virtual stars to our fighting stages, but the old ones started to protest.



Calling themselves the Federated Union of Fantastically Fictional Fighters (FUFFF), our roster of celebrity combatants has seized creative control. Their first, non-negotiable demand? To be removed from the "common rabble" of the Steam store.



They claim their brand is too exclusive, their art too refined for mass consumption. They are demanding that we vault the game, making it a legendary artifact available only to the chosen few who already own it.



This is not a drill. According to their virtual (and glitter-bombed) binding notice, we are required to delist Celebrity Kombat from Steam on October 15th, 2025.



We are in emergency negotiations to see if there is any way to appease these pixelated divas, but things look grim. We wanted you, our loyal community, to be the first to know.



Stay tuned. We're doing everything we can.



Sincerely (and with our servers held hostage),

The Team at Celebrity Kombat Corp.

notes.title: New Ultra Optimized version of Celebrity Kombat in Alpha Testing
notes.notes:
Hi Folks,

This is a simplified and lighter version of the main Celebrity Kombat game, which I worked very hard to release. Light has been decreased, textures have been shrunk, and pointless effects have been eliminated.

This version can be played online alongside the High Quality version, and the characters and movesets are identical. If you prioritize competition, this version should give you a more consistent frame rate.

Do not hesitate to report any bugs or texture issues you come across.

Stay tuned!
